Method of Attack: Collects data on installed apps, WiFi and Bluetooth-connected devices, and GPS locations
Performs ad fraud by clicking ads in the background without user consent
Registers device and receives configuration from remote server
Data collection every two days sending installed apps list, location history, MAC addresses to C2 server
Ad-clicking by injecting HTML into hidden WebView to perform multiple URL visits generating ad revenue
Impacted Systems: 60 legitimate Android apps on Google Play with 100 million downloads collectively
Attack Vector: Third-party library embedded in legitimate Android apps
Remote server configuration controlling data-stealing and ad-clicking functions
